description: This Java source file defines the DeviceConnectionClientImpl class, a client implementation for Hono's Device Connection API using Vertx and Proton. It includes methods for creating clients, setting and getting the last known gateway for a device, and handling AMQP messaging.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a client for Hono's Device Connection API, supporting operations like setting and getting last known gateway for devices, using AMQP links.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP target address for a given tenant ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name for device connection.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID for requests.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload and status into a DeviceConnectionResult object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new device connection client for a tenant, establishing AMQP links.

methods.name: createDeviceIdProperties
methods.description: Creates a map of properties including device ID for messaging.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last known gateway for a specific device via the Device Connection API.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway for a specific device via the Device Connection API.
